nodes.name: networkpolicy-webhooks.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template rendering a NetworkPolicy that restricts ingress traffic to the cert-manager webhook pods, with ingress rules supplied from .Values.webhook.networkPolicy.ingress.
nodes.languageNotes: Guarded by a Helm `if` on webhook.networkPolicy.enabled and uses `toYaml | nindent` to inject user-supplied ingress rules.

nodes.name: poddisruptionbudget.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating a PodDisruptionBudget for the cert-manager controller, defaulting to minAvailable: 1 unless the user sets minAvailable or maxUnavailable.

nodes.name: podmonitor.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template producing a Prometheus Operator PodMonitor that scrapes the cainjector, controller, and webhook pods on the http-metrics port, failing the render if ServiceMonitor is enabled at the same time.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses `fail` to enforce mutual exclusivity between the PodMonitor and ServiceMonitor chart options.

nodes.name: psp-clusterrole.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template defining a ClusterRole that grants the `use` verb on the cert-manager PodSecurityPolicy resource by name.

nodes.name: psp-clusterrolebinding.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template binding the cert-manager PSP ClusterRole to the controller ServiceAccount so the controller may use the PodSecurityPolicy.

nodes.name: psp.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template defining a restrictive PodSecurityPolicy for cert-manager controller pods, with non-privileged containers, fixed UID/GID 1000, and a whitelist of volume types.

nodes.name: rbac.yaml
nodes.summary: Large Helm template rendering the controller's full RBAC surface: leader-election and token-request Roles/RoleBindings plus ClusterRoles and ClusterRoleBindings for issuers, clusterissuers, certificates, orders, challenges, ingress-shim, approvals, certificate signing requests, and aggregated view/edit roles.
nodes.languageNotes: Emits roughly two dozen multi-document YAML resources from a single template, guarded by global.rbac.create and serviceAccount.create conditionals.

nodes.name: service.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating a ClusterIP Service exposing the controller's Prometheus metrics port 9402 for ServiceMonitor scraping, rendered only when Prometheus is enabled without PodMonitor.

nodes.name: serviceaccount.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating the cert-manager controller ServiceAccount with configurable image pull secrets, automount settings, annotations, and labels.

nodes.name: servicemonitor.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template rendering a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor that scrapes cert-manager component endpoints by target port, with a guard preventing simultaneous PodMonitor enablement.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-job.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template defining the post-install startup API check Job, which runs the cert-manager image with `check api --wait` to verify the API is serving before the release is considered healthy.
nodes.languageNotes: Merges global and component nodeSelector maps with the Helm `merge` function before rendering.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-psp-clusterrole.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template granting the `use` verb on the startup API check PodSecurityPolicy through a dedicated ClusterRole.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-psp-clusterrolebinding.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template binding the startup API check PSP ClusterRole to the startupapicheck ServiceAccount.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-psp.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template defining a PodSecurityPolicy for the startup API check Job pods, permitting only projected and secret volumes with fixed UID/GID 1000.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-rbac.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating a Role and RoleBinding that let the startup API check ServiceAccount create CertificateRequests during the post-install verification.

nodes.name: startupapicheck-serviceaccount.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating the startup API check ServiceAccount with configurable annotations, labels, automount token, and image pull secrets.

nodes.name: webhook-config.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template packaging the webhook's WebhookConfiguration values into a ConfigMap under config.yaml, defaulting apiVersion and kind before serializing with toYaml.
nodes.languageNotes: Mutates the values map in place with Helm's `set` before serializing it into the ConfigMap data field.

nodes.name: webhook-deployment.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template for the cert-manager webhook Deployment, wiring replicas, security context, feature gates, dynamic-serving CA secret flags, health and metrics ports, and the mounted webhook configuration ConfigMap.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive conditional templating covers hostNetwork/dnsPolicy, Prometheus scrape annotations, and configurable secure-port and healthz-port overrides.

nodes.name: webhook-mutating-webhook.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template registering the MutatingWebhookConfiguration that intercepts CREATE operations on cert-manager CertificateRequests and routes them to the webhook service's /mutate path.
nodes.languageNotes: Annotated with cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from-secret so cainjector populates the CA bundle from the webhook CA Secret.

nodes.name: webhook-poddisruptionbudget.yaml
nodes.summary: Helm template creating a PodDisruptionBudget for webhook pods, defaulting to minAvailable: 1 unless the user overrides availability settings.
